answer: A vote counts only from bonded ground. Each identity holds one plot in the meadow and posts a 40 POA bond on its ledge. Each epoch the roll deals each plot a fresh cipher; the owner signs it back within 60 seconds. Lottery wardens sample one plot in five per epoch, replaying its cipher and checking the ledge. A missed, stale, or shared echo shears the plot: the 40 POA on its ledge is slashed to the wardens, ballot struck, key benched two epochs. N fakes × 40 POA = 40N POA slashed. Honest keys lock the same 40.
